NetSurf 3.11 web browser and its libraries, vendored for NovaOS
===============================================================

Source: the netsurf-all-3.11 release (https://www.netsurf-browser.org/),
plus zlib and libpng.  Only the files the NovaOS build compiles are kept
(tools/build_netsurf.py; sources.json lists them per component).

Component        Version   Licence
---------        -------   -------
netsurf          3.11      GPL-2.0 only (netsurf/COPYING)
libcss           0.9.2     MIT
libdom           0.4.2     MIT
libhubbub        0.3.8     MIT
libparserutils   0.2.5     MIT
libwapcaplet     0.4.3     MIT
libnsbmp         0.1.7     MIT
libnsgif         1.0.0     MIT
libnsfb          0.2.2     MIT
libnspsl         0.1.7     MIT
libnsutils       0.1.1     MIT
libutf8proc      2.4.0     MIT (LICENSE.md)
libsvgtiny       0.1.8     MIT (libsvgtiny/COPYING)
expat            2.7.1     MIT (libexpat/COPYING)
zlib             1.3.1     zlib licence
libpng           1.6.50    libpng licence (PNG Reference Library License v2)

Each component keeps its licence file in its directory.  NetSurf itself is
GPL-2.0: netsurf.exe (built from this directory together with MIT/permissive
code) is therefore distributed under the GPL-2.0, and its complete source is
this directory plus userland/netsurf, userland/include and the NovaOS system
DLL sources in userland/.  The rest of NovaOS is MIT licensed; the kernel
image only carries netsurf.exe as a file for drive C: (like a disk image
carries programs), and building with NOVA_NO_NETSURF=1 leaves it out.

NetSurf's program icon
----------------------
netsurf/frontends/windows/res/NetSurf.ico is copied unmodified from the
release's Windows frontend (the only file kept from that frontend): it is
compiled into netsurf.exe's resources (userland/netsurf/netsurf.rc) so the
desktop and File Explorer show NetSurf's own icon.

Generated files
---------------
netsurf/generated/ holds the files NetSurf's own build generates on the
host (testament.h, the image-*.c resources): they were produced by running
the upstream build for the framebuffer frontend once (testament.h with the
build host's details replaced).
netsurf/generated/duktape/ holds the JavaScript DOM bindings, made by
NetSurf's nsgenbind 0.9 (from netsurf-all-3.11) with the upstream command,
run from netsurf/generated:
  nsgenbind -I ../content/handlers/javascript/WebIDL \
      ../content/handlers/javascript/duktape/netsurf.bnd duktape
(its Makefile fragment is not kept: the list of sources is in
sources.json), plus generics.js.inc and polyfill.js.inc, the two .js files
as C arrays (NetSurf's tools/xxd -i format).
libdom/include/dom/bindings/hubbub/{errors,parser}.h are copies of
libdom/bindings/hubbub/ (upstream installs them there), and
libdom/include/dom/bindings/xml/{xmlerror,xmlparser}.h of
libdom/bindings/xml/.

SVG
---
libsvgtiny is the netsurf-browser/libsvgtiny repository at commit
073283b29dd800e4d938db42af7e131db848bf3b (version 0.1.8; the release
tarball's site is not reachable from CI): include/ and src/.
src/autogenerated_colors.c is what its Makefile generates from
src/colors.gperf (gperf 3.1, then the Makefile's sed making the table
static).  libdom/bindings/xml/{expat_xmlparser.c,utils.h,xmlerror.h,
xmlparser.h} are libdom's XML binding from netsurf-browser/libdom at
commit f69781e1f062444b5af3f62d431d7d94018da53b (unchanged since 0.4.2
apart from constified tables), which libsvgtiny parses with.  libexpat/lib
is expat 2.7.1's lib/ (from its GitHub release) without winconfig.h, plus
expat_config.h written for NovaOS.

Changes for NovaOS
------------------
All marked with _NOVAOS / WITH_NOVA_HTTP / FB_USE_NOVA_FONT or a comment:

- netsurf/utils/config.h: a NovaOS block selects which POSIX features the
  C library provides (the rest use NetSurf's own fallbacks), no mmap, no
  IPv6.
- netsurf/frontends/framebuffer/gui.c: JavaScript is enabled by default
  (upstream's default is off).
- netsurf/content/fetch.c: registers the NovaOS HTTP(S) fetcher
  (userland/netsurf/fetch_nova.c) and makes the curl fetcher optional.
- netsurf/frontends/framebuffer/gui.c: window size from the desktop,
  cookies in C:\Programs\NetSurf; fixes scrolling of content shorter than
  the window (the top clamp is applied last); an area queued for redraw
  before a window resize is clipped to the browser widget's new size, so
  it never plots over the scroll bars.
- netsurf/frontends/framebuffer/{font.h,font_nova.h,framebuffer.c,
  fbtk/text.c}: hooks for the TrueType font driver
  (userland/netsurf/font_nova.c).
- netsurf/frontends/framebuffer/framebuffer.c: a path plotter (SVG's
  shapes), anti-aliased with plutovg (third_party/plutovg, MIT); upstream's
  framebuffer frontend has none.
- netsurf/content/handlers/image/svg.c: each reformat parses the SVG into
  an empty diagram (libsvgtiny adds to the old one's shapes).
- netsurf/content/handlers/html/{html.c,private.h,dom_event.c,
  box_construct.[ch],object.[ch]} and css/select.[ch]: pages a script
  changes after layout are laid out again: a DOM change or a late
  stylesheet rebuilds the box tree from the DOM (html_relayout), keeping
  the objects (images) of the old tree.
- netsurf/content/handlers/html/box_special.c and css/hints.c: an <svg>
  element inline in HTML is drawn as an image: its subtree is serialised
  and fetched as a data:image/svg+xml URL (box_inline_svg); its width and
  height attributes are presentational hints, as an <img>'s.

Not built: RISC OS sprites, PDF export, curl/OpenSSL (replaced by the NovaOS
fetcher and Mbed TLS), libnslog (NetSurf's plain logging is used), and the
bitmap font (font_internal.c and its generated glyphs, removed: replaced by
font_nova.c).  JPEG is decoded by stb_image
(userland/netsurf/jpeg_stb.c) instead of libjpeg.
